- **Nuvio 0.5.8-beta.** Includes everything in the official Nuvio 0.5.7-beta and 0.5.8-beta releases: Jellyfin and Emby servers (browse, play, sync watched), stream info and switch player in the player, MDBList list choice and release-date sorting, next-episode source preloading, Croatian, and more.
- **Memory buffer now comes from Nuvio.** Nuvio added its own ExoPlayer buffer settings in Settings > Playback, including native memory, which does what our "Larger memory buffer" did without the heap limit. Our switch is gone; turn on Nuvio's native memory if you used it. The Seek buffer disk cache in Settings > Nuvio Reshaped stays, and Nuvio's own VOD cache steps aside while it is on.
